items.title: 4.2 Choosing the Right Data Structure for the Problem

source_refs.note: Topic 4.2 (PDF 116-117, printed 113-114). MCQ 10 prints only three options; it is answered (c); the answer key gives (a). Recorded.

blocks.text: Choosing the right data structure makes solutions more efficient and easier to implement. The next topics say when each of the five structures, stack, queue, list, tree and graph, is most appropriate.
